subject: Demo request: Redwood for CareLoop
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@careloop.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Redwood for CareLoop

Hi Ava,

I signed up on your site yesterday and took a quick look at the hosted API. CareLoop is a digital health triage platform (we route patient messages to clinicians and automate basic triage). We're evaluating ML inference providers to replace our current, homegrown stack because of cost and latency issues.

High level:
- Use case: real-time triage + short-form summary generation for clinician review
- Volume estimate: ~400k-600k inference requests/month initially; spikes expected around mornings
- Latency requirement: p95 < 350ms for short summaries, ideally lower for triage responses
- Timeline: looking for a Q3 pilot (Aug) and decision by end of Q3

Would love a short demo and to understand pricing and private deployment options (we have PHI concerns). Are you available for a 30-min walkthrough next week? I'm in PDT.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Engineering, CareLoop
samir@careloop.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@careloop.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for CareLoop

Hi Samir — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up. I work on SDR/solutions at Redwood — happy to run the demo and loop in Marissa (AE) for pricing & architecture. Quick set of Qs so we tailor the demo: 

1) Which integrations will this connect to (API, EHR systems, webhooks)? Any specific compliance needs beyond PHI (e.g., Data residency in EU)?
2) What’s a typical request/response size (tokens or average characters) for the summaries?
3) Do you expect batching/async patterns (background processing) or mostly real-time single-request inference?
4) Any hard SLOs for latency or availability (p95/p99 targets, maintenance windows)?
5) Who is the decision owner and expected procurement timeline / budget band?

If it helps, I have the following windows next week (PDT):
- Fri, Jul 16: 10:00–10:30 AM or 3:00–3:30 PM
- Mon, Jul 19: 2:00–2:30 PM

Or you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30min

Agenda we propose: quick intro (5m), workload & success criteria (5m), demo of hosted + dedicated options and observability (15m), next steps (5m). If you want a deeper architecture/PII discussion, we'll add Marissa and a Solutions Engineer.

Thanks — feel free to reply with answers to the Qs and which slot works.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Specialist | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@careloop.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@careloop.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for CareLoop

Thanks Ava — answers below and Fri 10:00 AM PT works. Adding Elena (product) to the thread.

1) Integrations: primary is inbound messages via our API + outgoing webhooks to our platform for clinician routing. We don't currently integrate with EHRs in the pilot. PHI is a concern; we need SOC2 + customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest.
2) Request size: short messages, typically 60–200 tokens per request; average ~120 tokens.
3) Real-time: mostly single-request, low-latency inference. We may batch for async jobs later but the pilot is real-time.
4) SLOs: p95 < 350ms; p99 < 600ms would be ideal. Availability: 99.9% SLA required for production.
5) Decision owner: Samir (Eng) + Elena (Product) for prioritization; procurement team engaged if pilot looks good. Timeline: pilot in Aug, decision by end of Q3. Ballpark budget: evaluating options, prefer committed pricing if the economics are right.

Let's book Fri, Jul 16 10:00 AM PT. Please send calendar invite and meeting link.

—Samir
